meta.baseline: head and tail 'ends' (outstore.present: 900 head : 400 tail) sized to the same output chars as the skeleton, tag line counted

definitions.rare: lowercased unit types in exactly one line
definitions.common: types in the top decile by line df (df >= 2)
definitions.ident: unit contains _ . / : \ @ # or a lower-upper step or letters and digits
definitions.retention: type counts as retained when any occurrence has >= min(len, 6) chars inside kept spans; whole = any occurrence fully kept; pooled over blobs (sum retained / sum types)
definitions.ms: wall time of the first stripe call per row, warm process, not part of determinism

thresholds.note: provisional, docs/STRIPE.md section 7; n >= 2000 and reduced
